corrections.issue: Wrong month. Katie answers Alan's question about this month (December 2024): the currency trade is the biggest mover this month, after last month's (November) Trump trade of long equities, long dollar and short fixed income.
corrections.fix: Currencies were the biggest and most consistent trend in December 2024, following November's Trump-trade positioning; currencies do not usually drive trend returns, but when they work it is exciting.
